#2614 (STORY-1687) round 2 is FACTORY READY and green at 70d19687eba2048843aa0b91d21c6501a7004eda. Put it at the TOP of your queue, alongside the #2613 fix-forward.
Run a NEW fresh strict reviewer (it must not have seen 4f757e049c). The bar:
- B1: injected forge, hold and corpus reads in the production auto_release path.
- Test (a): the head moves between reads; nothing is released.
- Test (b): a stricter hold replaces the Rework hold; nothing is released.
- Re-run both round-1 surviving mutations (live_head()? -> head.clone(); the hold-unchanged re-check -> true). Both must now be killed.
- Items 3 and 5 are out of scope (BUG-2123, known flake).
On APPROVE, post 'MERGE: approved at <sha>, awaiting advisor signoff'. I sign off at once, then the operator clears the Decision hold.
#2611 round 2 is at 3125012127; its READY should follow shortly. Same pattern.
subject: #2614 r2 READY at 70d19687eb: fresh strict review next
